title: The Crab Derby, 2005
logline: Twenty-first annual. Two crabs, a cup. Gully's got a kid on his hip — no, a neighbor's. Not yet.

panels.composition: Gully's. The counter. GULLY with the twenty, and a neighbor's toddler on his hip, easy, like a sack of bait. WOOD.

characters.pose: twenty out, a toddler on his hip

balloons.text: Delgados'. They're on the boat. Draw.

image.prompt: a young man in a fisherman's apron holding out a twenty-dollar bill with a toddler balanced easily on his hip, another young man with a drawing pad at a shop counter, a crowded corkboard behind, muddy digital flats

panels.composition: Wood drawing. The toddler watching the pen with the same expression the dog had in 2000.

image.prompt: close-up of a toddler watching a pen draw a crab with rapt attention, a dog watching too

panels.composition: The flyer: two crabs, a cup, and — the toddler grabbed the pen — a scribble across the corner. Wood leaves it.
props: flyer with a scribble in the corner

image.prompt: a hand-drawn crab flyer with a child's scribble across one corner, a young man looking at it and deciding to keep it

panels.composition: Eight flyers. The eighth has a scribble. The toddler asleep on Gully's shoulder. The dog asleep on the floor. Wood, twenty bucks, pocket.

image.prompt: eight crab flyers in a row on a shingle wall, a young man in an apron with a toddler asleep on his shoulder, another pocketing a bill, a dog asleep, no words

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The first child in the strip. Not Gully's. The strip is practicing.
